content.text: {"id": "mm6325a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "an estimated 21.3% of U.S. adults used any tobacco product every day or some days"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "prevalence of any tobacco use every day or some days was higher among men (26.2%) than women (15.4%)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Tobacco use prevalence estimates were calculated overall and by sex, age, race/ethnicity"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "an estimated 21.3% of U.S. adults (50 million persons) reported use of any tobacco product every day or some days"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Differences between groups were assessed using chi-squared statistics (p<0.05)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence of every day, some days, or rarely use was significantly higher than every day or some day use"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "is a stratified, national random-digit–dialed landline and cellular telephone survey of 60,192 noninstitutionalized U.S. adults"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "was significantly lower than the prevalence observed in the 2009–2010 NATS (19.5%)"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence estimates with a relative standard error ≥30% were omitted."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Differences between groups were assessed using chi-squared statistics (p<0.05)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data were weighted to provide nationally representative estimates."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Participants with missing responses for any of the assessed tobacco products (1.6% of respondents) were excluded."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
